title: Workshop Spend under a Care Plan and the Rate a Vehicle Steps Down At
content:
A vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing that is being spent on in the workshop steps down more slowly, and what is read is the workshop invoices standing under that vehicle's Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan in the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date.

- A vehicle carrying workshop invoices of 1200 USD or more under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan in that window steps down at three quarters of the rate that otherwise applies.
- A vehicle carrying such invoices of 400 USD or more but under 1200 USD steps down at nine tenths of the rate that otherwise applies.
- A vehicle carrying less than 400 USD of such invoices steps down at the rate as it stands.

### Worked on hypothetical figures

Take a monthly rate of nine thousandths before this rule is read.

- Workshop invoices of 1450 USD in the window: three quarters of nine thousandths is six and three quarters thousandths a month.
- Workshop invoices of 600 USD in the window: nine tenths of nine thousandths is eight and one tenth thousandths a month.
- Workshop invoices of 250 USD in the window: the rate stands at nine thousandths a month.

*At the boundaries.* Invoices totalling exactly 1200 USD are on the first clause; 1199.99 USD is on the second. Invoices totalling exactly 400 USD are on the second clause; 399.99 USD is on the third.
